operators.name: custom_mean_dim1
semantics: Computes mean over dimension 1 (channels) with keepdim=True, matching torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True).
Reduction is performed over the channel axis, preserving batch, height, width dimensions.
Output is a new contiguous tensor with shape [N, 1, H, W] and dtype float32.

operators.name: custom_leaky_relu
semantics: Applies LeakyReLU with the given negative_slope, matching torch.nn.LeakyReLU(negative_slope).
For each element y = x if x > 0 else negative_slope * x.
Output shape and strides match the input tensor.
Reduces input tensor over channel dimension (dim=1) by computing the mean.
Keepdim=True preserves the reduced dimension as size 1.
Applies LeakyReLU activation with negative_slope=0.01 to the mean output.
Elementwise operation preserving shape [N, 1, H, W].
Returns the final tensor after LeakyReLU.
Shape [N, 1, H, W] and dtype float32.
